comparison_limits: No direct measured SPARC Vobs use was found in the selected mass, lapse, circulation and canonical-prior constructor chain. This scoped source audit does not certify every historical parameter or branch selection as out-of-sample.

The frozen circulation is kinematically conditioned by an earlier modeled circular orbit. A new metric readout can be compared descriptively with observed rotation, but is not automatically a self-consistent stationary ordinary flow with the frozen p_phi.

Photometric mass, adopted distance/inclination, fixed M/L, gas profile, EPS/background, finite boundaries and declared continuation branch remain conditioning inputs. Their independent calibration or possible selection through earlier comparisons needs separate provenance before a claim of an independent predictive test.

The next finite solve must keep fixed inventories and vary the geometry-dependent York target consistently; it must not freeze old total metric momentum while also varying that target. Physical acceptance still requires new canonical/normal/CMC and ordinary/junction/evolution qualifications.
diagonal_reflected_sheet_circle: For the current conformal diagonal sheet snapshot with only beta^phi nonzero and held zero gauge time rates, D=N^2-h_phiphi*(beta^phi+Omega)^2.
The R Euler equation is E_R=(beta^phi+Omega)*hdot_Rphi + (1/2)*partial_R D, where D=-g(k,k), k=(1,0,0,Omega). Hence hdot_Rphi can change a radial root even with fixed N/beta.

The Z equation on the strict plus side is E_Z=(1/2)*partial_Z D when hdot_Zphi is masked to zero. This is a bulk one-sided condition; a reflection-symmetric sheet trajectory instead needs the declared mean/intrinsic junction convention.

Time and axial equations depend on hdot_phiphi and the held gauge jets and determine proper-clock drift and Omegadot. Other hdot entries remain material for general tracer dynamics even when they drop out of this special circular tangent contraction.
chi changes spatial h/h_R/h_Z and therefore the radial balance and metric-observer speed; fixed lapse does not algebraically freeze the prediction.
fixed_gauge_metric_map: With fixed N,beta, g_ij=h_ij, g_0i=h_ij beta^j, g_00=-N^2+beta^i h_ij beta^j.
chi controls rho=S chi and h=exp(4rho) h_ref; spatial h_a=exp(4rho)(h_ref,a+4rho_a h_ref). This changes metric and its R/Z derivatives despite fixed lapse and shift.
W and total canonical t vary the prepared York momentum target, then the candidate-dependent Legendre solve changes mechanical time rates. They do not directly change snapshot h at fixed chi.
All six physical hdot entries are independent F-rate directions; hdot is not constrained to conformal 4*rhodot*h.

gdot_ij=hdot_ij; gdot_0i=hdot_ij beta^j+h_ij betadot^j; gdot_00=beta^T hdot beta+2 beta^T h betadot-2N Ndot. Owned gauge time words are held. The reference diagnostic uses its declared Ndot=betadot=0.
Native u/z and phase rates enter the coupled canonical solve but not g/dg directly. Their impact on a geodesic readout is mediated through the solved physical hdot/configuration.

measured_velocity_provenance.finding: published_data reads the full official table for custody/comparison, but the density constructor receives only R and SBdisk, with M/L=.5 and declared EXP24/Rd continuation. It explicitly excludes Vobs and velocity components.

The fixed weak-static lapse/mode BVP builds its RHS from the photometric/gas surface load and charged background law, uses zero outer/top fields and declared parity masks. observation_rows enters the later predicted-speed/residual reporting loop, not the RHS shown here.

source_profiles reads only table columns R and SBdisk. circular_sheet computes u=R*B*model_potential_slope, v=sqrt(u/(1-u)), gamma=1/sqrt(1-v^2), rho=R*exp(-Phi), then the odd rotating source from mass*model gamma*v. This v is a modeled circular speed, not SPARC Vobs.

The source worldline uses Omega0=exp(oldPhi)*model_v/oldrho from those saved samples. It is held when the odd-shift metric changes; the code stores radial and one-sided/mean vertical force defects instead of claiming equilibrium.
p_phi=g_phi(k)/sqrt(-g(k,k)) is computed from that model-conditioned source worldline and metric; the source angular momentum is not directly replaced by a measured speed.

source_projection copies immutable mass_weight/source_g/p_phi and sets spatial p=(0,0,p_phi), then projects its canonical energy/shift loads. Later fixed-p force and finite-sheet routes inherit these labels and momenta.

Native/metric canonical priors are copied or computed action momenta of the owned reference Cauchy state, then scattered into current_Pn/current_Pm and affine RHS. They are model/reference priors, not identified here as observed orbital momenta. No direct Vobs input occurs in these selected prior constructors.

physical_scope: Initial canonical, normal and CMC equations plus genuine first jets can support a conditional instantaneous local readout. They do not establish stationarity, a Killing circular orbit, source Euler equilibrium, junction consistency, persistence, stability or an evolved tracer history.

A stationary galaxy prediction requires the relevant evolution and material equations and boundary/junction conditions to be satisfied; an instantaneous diagnostic does not require pretending such a history is already earned.

The +Z acceleration norm is not by itself a stability test or a necessary zero condition for an intrinsic reflected-sheet trajectory. The source implementation already stores plus/minus normal forces and their zero reflected mean.
scope: Read source text only; no scientific function or NPZ payload evaluated; no source, gates, shared log or current calculation changed.
